topPRs.title: fix: drop broken CJS build (cannot load async ESM @elizaos/core)
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## What this fixes The CJS bundle this plugin ships at `dist/cjs/index.node.cjs` does `require("@elizaos/core")` at the top level. `@elizaos/core` is now an ESM-only package that uses top-level await internally; CJS cannot synchronously require an async module, so any consumer resolving this plugin's `require` export hits: ``` TypeError: require() async module "@elizaos/core" is unsupported. use "await import()" instead. ``` ## Fix Drop CJS support to match the established pattern in `@elizaos/plugin-anthropic` (which already shipped this fix): - `package.json`: `main` → ESM build, remove `require` condition from `exports` - `build.ts`: remove the `Bun.build({ format: "cjs" })` step (where present) - `dist/cjs/` deleted ESM Node + ESM Browser builds are unchanged. Consumers using `import` / `await import()` are unaffected. Consumers using `require()` will now get a clean "no \"require\" condition" resolver error pointing them at dynamic import — much better than the misleading "async module unsupported" crash. ## Context PR #5 ("dual build cjs / esm") was closed without merging — that decision is consistent with this fix. `@elizaos/core` going ESM-only makes shipping a CJS bundle structurally impossible for any plugin that imports anything from core. ## Tested This plugin loaded by a self-hosted milady runtime on bun 1.3.13 across full agent boot; with the fix, the runtime no longer hits the require()-async-module TypeError when this plugin is in the active set.

Greptile Summary

This PR drops the CJS bundle from `@elizaos/plugin-openai` because `@elizaos/core` is now ESM-only (uses top-level `await`), making a synchronous `require()` path structurally broken. The fix mirrors the approach already taken in `@elizaos/plugin-anthropic`: `main` is redirected to the ESM node build, the `require` export condition is removed, and the `Bun.build({ format: "cjs" })` step is deleted from `build.ts`.

Confidence Score: 4/5

Safe to merge — the fix is structurally sound and the only findings are two stale comments in build.ts. All findings are P2 (cosmetic stale comments). The package.json and build changes are correct, consistent with the plugin-anthropic precedent, and address a real runtime crash for CJS consumers. typescript/build.ts — two leftover comments from the deleted CJS block should be cleaned up.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | typescript/build.ts | Removes the CJS build step, directory creation, and declaration output — two stale comments remain (file header and orphaned section label). | | typescript/package.json | Points `main` to the ESM node build and removes the `require` condition from the exports map — consistent with `"type": "module"` and the plugin-anthropic pattern. |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[bun run build.ts] --> B[Node ESM build\ndist/node/index.node.js] A --> C[Browser ESM build\ndist/browser/index.browser.js] A --> D[TypeScript declarations\ndist/index.d.ts] B --> E[package.json main\ndist/node/index.node.js] B --> F[exports node import\ndist/node/index.node.js] C --> G[exports browser import\ndist/browser/index.browser.js] R[REMOVED: CJS build\ndist/cjs/index.node.cjs]:::removed S[REMOVED: exports require\ndist/cjs/index.node.cjs]:::removed classDef removed fill:#ffcccc,stroke:#cc0000,color:#660000 ```

Comments Outside Diff (1)

 1. `typescript/build.ts`, line 8 ([link](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/plugin-openai/blob/20d10b6c800ebdff28c67c881bdaf4420d7ebd3b/typescript/build.ts#L8)) **Stale header comment references removed CJS artifact** The file-level JSDoc still lists `dist/cjs/index.node.cjs (CommonJS for Node.js)` as a produced output, but that build step has been deleted. This will mislead readers about what the script actually produces.
